'''Blackie''' was a thief who, with his partner [[Cravel]], took over a [[Blackie's|junkyard]] in [[Vorrnti City]] with the intention of using a derelict [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] it contained to steal some [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. They were thwarted by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and the [[Katarn Commandos]], however, and Calrissian claimed the AT-AT as his own.
